prompt.STACK: Kotlin (JVM, Java 25) + Spring Boot + Spring Data JPA (Hibernate) + SQLite, built with Gradle (Kotlin DSL) using the installed `gradle` command
prompt.WORKERS: Spring Boot's embedded Tomcat with its thread pool sized to the core count

scanner.name: osv
argv: d=$(mktemp -d) && printf 'allprojects { dependencyLocking { lockAllConfigurations() } }\n' > "$d/lock.gradle" && gradle -q --no-daemon --init-script "$d/lock.gradle" dependencies --write-locks 1>&2 && find . -name gradle.lockfile -not -path '*/build/*' -exec cat {} + > "$d/all" && c=runtimeClasspath && { grep -q productionRuntimeClasspath "$d/all" && c=productionRuntimeClasspath; true; } && grep -E "=(.*,)?$c(,|\$)" "$d/all" | sed -E 's/=.*/=runtimeClasspath/' | sort -u > "$d/gradle.lockfile" && [ -s "$d/gradle.lockfile" ] && osv-scanner scan source --format json -L "$d/gradle.lockfile"
